data.long_meaning: Eliyass is the Arabic form of Elijah, a prophet in Islam. He is considered a righteous and devoted servant of Allah. The name Eliyass carries the meaning “Prophet Elijah's name” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eliyass usually hope their child will grow to embody prophet elijah's name and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Ilyas (Eliyass) is mentioned as a prophet who was steadfast in his prayer and devotion to Allah (Quran 6:85).
data.etymology: Eliyass belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prophet Elijah's name.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eliyass total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إلياس

in_urdu.name: الیاس
in_urdu.long_meaning: نبی الیاس علیہ السلام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کردہ نبی ہیں، اور اسلام میں ان کی высокی مقام ہے، وہ بني اسرائیل کو بھیجے گئے انبیاء میں سے ایک ہیں، اور وہ اسلام میں انصاف اور سखتی کے نمونے کے طور پر سمجھے جاتے ہیں

data.cultural_impact: Eliyass was a prophet in both Judaism and Christianity, and his significance extends to Islam as well. He is known for his strong faith, morality, and ability to perform miracles. The Arabic name "Eliyass" honors this revered figure's legacy and perpetuates his influence within Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Eliyass is regarded as an intercessor and a protector. He is believed to carry the throne of Allah on his head, symbolizing his close connection and devotion to the divine. Naming a child Eliyass reflects the parents' hope for their child to embody the moral and spiritual virtues that Eliyass embodied - unwavering faith, selflessness, courage, and a strong connection to Allah.

modern_usage.modern_context: Eliyass is a variant of the Arabic name Elias, which is derived from the Hebrew name Elia, meaning 'God is my God'. It is a name with historical significance, having been borne by prominent scholars and philosophers in the Arab world during the Mamluk period. Today, it is used as a given name in the Arab world and can be found on various platforms such as social media and genealogy websites.
